name: Render queue
oneLiner: a glass export queue of four jobs cut from the brand's screens and photo: two render at once, each thumbnail fills from grey to colour behind a scan line as its bar and percent climb, each finish flips the bar green and pops a green tick, the counter climbs, and when the last lands the header pill turns green and reads all done
say: when the speaker says everything gets exported or made in one go ('it renders the full video and every short at once', 'hit export and walk away'): the jobs render while they explain, all done lands on 'done' or 'ready'
